 Reel Surprise ChartersAngling & Adventure on the Alabama Gulf Coast
Angling & Adventure on the Alabama Gulf Coast
Charter Fishing in Orange BeachFrom shared trips to private fishing charters, experience the thrill of Gulf fishing with our family-owned fleet. Spacious vessels, a local and bi-lingual crew, and four unique ways to land your next big catch of the day.
Learn MoreFull-Service Marina + Dock StoreOur boutique marina at SanRoc Cay in Orange Beach is closest to the Gulf and equipped with premium slips, a fully-stocked dock store with fuel, shopping and restaurants, clean restroom facilities and more.
More DetailsFast Fishing FactsWhat should I bring? How long do trips last? Is there a bathroom? We’ve covered everything you need to know to plan your perfect day on the water with Reel Surprise Charters in our Frequently Asked Questions.
FAQsFamily-Owned Fishing Since 1999We’ve got more than 20 years of memories on our trophy wall! Treat your family to an Orange Beach fishing adventure with a local team of lifelong anglers dedicated to making your day perfect on the water.
About UsFind Your Perfect Orange Beach Fishing CharterReady to get hooked on the ultimate Orange Beach fishing adventure? From shared adventures to private excursions, our family-owned fleet offers four unique ways to experience Gulf fishing at its finest. Hop aboard our spacious head boat with just 36 fellow anglers (we believe in room to reel!) or book a small group fishing trip led by our expert team.
With our bilingual crew and prime location just a hop, skip, and a cast from the Gulf, you’ll be dropping lines in no time. Whether you’re a first-timer or a seasoned pro, it’s time to stop fishing for excuses and start planning your next angling adventure in Orange Beach with Reel Surprise Charters.
Reel Surprise Fishing ChartersHop aboard Reel Surprise, our 65’ Bonner head boat, for an unforgettable group fishing charter in Orange Beach! With an air-conditioned cabin, two convenient restrooms, and a cozy 35-passenger limit, there’s plenty of space to reel in the memories. More room, more fun, more fish – perfect for families and first-timers.
3-10 hoursAll Ages
Up to 35 Passengers
Book NowInshore Fishing ChartersExperience Orange Beach inshore charter fishing at its best! Perfect for beginners and pros alike, this trip offers a variety of fishing styles along the calm and scenic waters of our Orange Beach coastline. Reel in redfish, speckled trout, Spanish mackerel, and more, with a chance to snag a rare gem like cobia.
4-6 hoursAll AgesUp to 4 PassengersBook NowSix-Passenger ChartersBook a private fishing charter in Orange Beach for up to 6 guests. Reel in prized catches, keep what you catch (as long as it’s in season and legal), and create memories that meet—and exceed—your expectations. Perfect for families, small groups, corporate teams and more!

4-10 hours
All AgesUp to 6 PassengersBook NowDock, Stock, and Cast at Reel Surprise Marina in Orange BeachDrop anchor at Orange Beach’s premier boutique marina! With 54 premium slips and a fully stocked dock store located behind the SanRoc Cay shopping and dining district, we offer the personal service of a family-owned marina with the comfort of upscale shopping, waterfront restaurants and coastal charm. Whether you’re fueling up or gearing up, our friendly crew and full-service amenities make every trip an adventure worth casting off for!
High-speed fuel pumps
Clean restrooms and showers
30- and 50-amp hookups
3 fish-cleaning stations
Snacks, bait, and gear in our dock store
What our Guests are Saying
Great day out fishing. They put us on some Red Snapper and everyone got their limit. Best price in town for a walk on/head boat. Good help from the mates and the captain was great. My granddaughter caught her first deep sea fish and made me proud. Would go back.
Rick B. 
The Reel Surprise crew worked very hard to get enough people out today on a charter that we had 9 people interested. We all had a great day. They put us on the fish. Limited out on Red Snapper, which we haven’t been able to keep in many years. Thank you all for a great day!
Lorrie W.
We have loved all three of our trips out this summer. Hoping to do one more before we head home. Captain is a great guy, and first mates all are amazing!! Elizabeth is the boom!! We will never go anywhere else! We are hooked and LOVE Reel Surprise Charters!
Becky T.
We had such an amazing adventure, and we were treated like FAMILY.
Adam H. 
Had a great time fishing with Reel Surprise. The Captain and deck hands were very friendly and knowledgeable. We had an absolute blast and caught plenty of fish on our six hour excursion. Highly recommend this place and we’ll be back again next Summer.
Nate R.

 Aboutadmin 
 Reel Surprise ChartersDecades of Fine Family Fishing in Orange BeachReel Surprise Charters is more than just a fishing fleet – it’s a family tradition. Meet the crew behind our charters and dive into Gulf Coast fishing with the area’s most trusted family-owned team.
Every great catch comes with a story, and Reel Surprise Charters is no different.
Every great catch comes with a story, and Reel Surprise Charters is no different.
Our tale starts with a plucky young deckhand, a savvy charter coordinator, and a shared dream of creating something special on these waters. Add in a clever joke and a love of great surprises, and you’ve got a reel adventure on your hands.
Anchors & BeginningsRandy Boggs fell in love with Orange Beach fishing during his teenage years. In 1999, Randy traded his deck shoes for a captain’s hat when he purchased the F/V Seafood, a 38’ Infinity vessel, and set up in a local marina. It was there he met Susan, a Texas transplant who was mastering the art of matching eager anglers with the perfect fishing trip as a charter agent. Together, they built more than just a fishing business – they created a floating family of charter fleets and a trusted reputation for big fish and boutique service.
Fishing For More: Reel Surprise ChartersAs their business began, Randy and Susan needed a name for their new headboat. A good friend joked that it would be a “real surprise” when it came to Orange Beach – and they were immediately hooked. Reel Surprise was born.
Our inshore and offshore fishing charters in Orange Beach are now a “must-do” adventure on Alabama’s beaches. From quick trips to troll for mackerel to deep sea charters for longer casts and larger fish, we offer something for newbies, pros, and everything in between. With decades of experience right here on the Gulf and a local crew of expert anglers, you won’t find a better guide on the Gulf for your next fishing story.
Not Your Average MarinaToday, Reel Surprise Marina is a boutique harbor with 54 boat slips, making us the “just right” size to know every boat, captain, and guest by name. Being closest to the Gulf means less time traveling and more time fishing – because who doesn’t want to be first to the fishing grounds? And our convenient location at SanRoc Cay means easy access to premium shopping outlets, gourmet restaurants, and our fully-stocked dock store with essential supplies for your day on the waves.
Family, Fish, and FutureHere at Reel Surprise, we believe great fishing starts with great people. Our experienced captains know where the fish are biting, our deckhands are always ready to lend a hand, and our marina staff treats every guest like family. We pride ourselves on limiting passengers for room to reel, providing the best bait and tackle in the business, and chartering fishing trips that are fun for all ages. Because at the end of the day, it’s not just about the fish you catch – it’s about the memories you make and the stories you’ll tell.
Whether you’re a seasoned angler or still learning the difference between the line and the lure, you’ll find our family-led, bilingual crew ready to help create your perfect day on the water. Come drop anchor with us and reel in good times on the Gulf Coast.
